chemistry-killer-10.title: Reaction rate, Le Chatelier's principle and chemical cells
chemistry-killer-10.topic: Reaction rate, Le Chatelier's principle and chemical cells
chemistry-killer-10.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-10.material:
Di following na di equilibrium of di ammonia synthesis reaction. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (exothermic reaction). For inside closed container wey get constant temperature wey don reach equilibrium, dem change di conditions separately as follows and e reach new equilibrium.
(I) Dem reduce di volume of di container while dem keep di temperature constant.
(II) Dem raise di temperature while dem keep di volume constant.
(III) Dem add Ar(g) wey no dey react while dem keep di temperature and volume constant.
(IV) Dem add Ar(g) to increase di volume while dem keep di temperature and pressure (total pressure) constant.
(V) Dem add $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ while dem keep di temperature and volume constant.
Which one choose all and only di cases wey di amount (mol) of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ for di new equilibrium increase pass di first equilibrium?

chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.prompt:
Di following na di equilibrium of di ammonia synthesis reaction. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (exothermic reaction). For inside closed container wey get constant temperature wey don reach equilibrium, dem change di conditions separately as follows and e reach new equilibrium.
(I) Dem reduce di volume of di container while dem keep di temperature constant.
(II) Dem raise di temperature while dem keep di volume constant.
(III) Dem add Ar(g) wey no dey react while dem keep di temperature and volume constant.
(IV) Dem add Ar(g) to increase di volume while dem keep di temperature and pressure (total pressure) constant.
(V) Dem add $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ while dem keep di temperature and volume constant.
Which one choose all and only di cases wey di amount (mol) of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ for di new equilibrium increase pass di first equilibrium?
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.explain:
Step 1: Di moles of reacting gas na 4 moles of reactants → 2 moles of products. Di forward reaction na exothermic.
Step 2: (I) Volume decrease = pressure increase → e dey shift to di forward reaction direction wey moles of gas dey reduce → NH3 increase.
(II) Temperature rise → reverse reaction, wey be di endothermic direction → NH3 decrease.
(III) Even if dem add Ar for constant volume, di concentrations (partial pressures) of N2, H2 and NH3 remain di same, so Q = K stay → no shift, NH3 no change.
(IV) If dem add Ar for constant pressure, di volume go increase and di concentration of all di reacting gases go decrease → e go shift to di reverse reaction wey moles of gas dey increase → NH3 decrease.
(V) Add $\mathrm{H_2}$ → Q < K → forward reaction → some H2 go finish and NH3 go increase (di amount in mol of NH3 go increase).
Step 3: Di cases wey di amount of NH3 increase: (I), (V).
Answer: (I), (V) (b).
